stories.short: Investissement de 1,3 Md£ dans Sizewell C
stories.story_fr: Centrica a engage 1,3 milliard £ (plafonne) pour 3,2 GW dans la centrale nucleaire Sizewell C, avec un rendement reglemente reel garanti, securisant des revenus previsibles a long terme pour le Groupe.
stories.story_en: Centrica committed a capped GBP 1.3bn for 3.2GW in the Sizewell C nuclear power station, with a real allowed regulated return, securing predictable long-term returns for the Group.
stories.quote: £1.3bn capped investment in 3.2GW Sizewell C nuclear power station with a real allowed return on investment

stories.story_fr: Sur les 4 milliards £ du programme d'investissement a horizon 2028, Centrica en a desormais engage 3 milliards £, incluant Sizewell C, Grain LNG et le Meter Asset Provider, soutenant la croissance des benefices reglementes.
stories.story_en: Of the GBP 4bn investment programme to end-2028, Centrica has now committed GBP 3bn, including Sizewell C, Grain LNG and the Meter Asset Provider, underpinning regulated earnings growth.
stories.quote: We have now committed £3bn of the £4bn investment programme to the end of 2028

stories.short: Croissance organique des clients sur tous les metiers
stories.story_fr: Centrica a realise une croissance organique de ses clients sur l'ensemble de ses activites de fourniture d'energie simultanement, dont +81k en residentiel British Gas Energy (croissance organique nette +12k) au S1 2025.
stories.story_en: Centrica achieved organic customer growth across all its energy supply businesses simultaneously, including +81k in British Gas Energy residential (net organic growth +12k) in H1 2025.
stories.quote: Customer numbers for the period increased by 81k in British Gas Energy residential, including net organic growth of 12k, by 17k in Bord Gáis Energy and by 7k in small business customer sites.

stories.short: Programme d'adhesion British Gas en plein essor
stories.story_fr: Le programme d'adhesion British Gas a recrute pres de 600 000 membres en 2025, et les interventions a la demande (on-demand jobs) ont progresse de 28% sur l'annee, ouvrant de nouveaux segments de revenus recurrents.
stories.story_en: The British Gas membership programme attracted almost 600,000 members in 2025, and on-demand jobs grew 28% over the year, opening new recurring revenue segments.
stories.quote: On-demand jobs grew 28% in 2025, and we now have almost 600,000 members who have joined our membership programme

stories.short: 12 TWh de generation incrementale en Irlande
stories.story_fr: Centrica a porte sa generation electrique incrementale a environ 12 TWh, dont +3 TWh ajoutes en septembre 2025, via de nouvelles centrales de pointe au gaz et turbines a cycle ouvert en Irlande sous contrats de capacite pluriannuels.
stories.story_en: Centrica raised its incremental power generation to approximately 12 TWh, including +3 TWh added in September 2025, via new gas peaking plants and open-cycle turbines in Ireland under multi-year capacity contracts.
stories.quote: announced in September 2025 added 3TWh of incremental generation, taking the total incremental to approximately 12TWh.

stories.story_fr: Centrica a acheve son programme de rachat d'actions de 2 milliards £ en janvier 2026 (un quart du capital rachete) et augmente son dividende par action 2025 de 22% a 5,5p, retournant 1,1 milliard £ aux actionnaires en 2025.
stories.story_en: Centrica completed its GBP 2bn share buyback programme in January 2026 (a quarter of share capital repurchased) and raised its FY2025 dividend per share by 22% to 5.5p, returning GBP 1.1bn to shareholders in 2025.
stories.quote: 2025 full year dividend per share increased by 22% to 5.5p, and £2bn share buyback completed.
